content.text:
{
 "query": "butcher meat grocery artisan food shop warm cream red editorial",
 "filters": {
  "industry": "food-beverage"
 },
 "count": 4,
 "tip": "Thumbnails inline. Top rows carry the fold autopsy; get_screen(slug) for the others. Hero complete inside 1280x800; 80-160px between sections; copy in a centered padded column.",
 "images": "https://0nme3pk5am3urwa9.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/captures/<slug>/hero.1440.webp (also full.1440, thumb.384, mobile.384; get_screen returns exact URLs)",
 "results": [
  {
   "slug": "grassrootscoop-com",
   "title": "Buy Grass Fed Meat Online | Healthy, Pastured Meats Delivered - Grass Roots Farmers' Cooperative",
   "northstar": "Soft, earthy tones and generous spacing evoke a tranquil, spacious, and thoughtfully curated feeling.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Top olive banner with white text. Nav: logo left, center links (SHOP dropdowns, RECIPES), icons right. Hero: white card (left ~30%) with \"Feed Your Family Food You Can Trust\" (title case, 4 lines, serif), body copy below, olive rectangular CTA \"SHOP CUSTOMER FAVORITES\". Full-bleed pastoral photo of cattle in sunlit field (right ~70%, extends behind card edge). Headline and card float over left; visual dominates right. Balance: 1/3 text, 2/3 image.\n\nTYPE: Display: Lora serif, light weight, wide, elegant. Body: Source Sans Pro/Noto Sans sans. Scale jump ~3:1. Title case headlines, sentence case body. No tracking quirks.\n\nCOLOR: Background #d7d3a1 (banner), white card; text #4e5823 (dark olive); accent #878139 (olive buttons, links). CTA button filled olive with white text.\n\nSIGNATURE: White text card overlapping full-bleed pastoral photography - editorial magazine layout on agricultural e-commerce, with sun-flare photo bleeding to all edges while card maintains crisp margin.",
   "palette": ["#878139", "#d7d3a1", "#4e5823", "#8a8f61", "#bcc4b7"],
   "fonts": ["Lora", "Source Sans Pro"],
   "mode": "light",
   "macro": "split-studio",
   "axes": "mid / roman-serif / chromatic-other (~105) / Lora",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial, swiss · food-beverage, ecommerce · warm, calm, soft · hero-fullbleed, logo-cloud, hero-with-cta"
  },
  {
   "slug": "goodeggs-com",
   "title": "Organic Grocery Delivery - Meal solutions and grocery items from the Deli, Bakery, Pantry, and more.",
   "northstar": "Warm ochre and soft cream, humanist sans shaping spacious, airy culinary storytelling.",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Nav top bar: logo left, utility links center-left, delivery location + account right. Secondary nav: category pills in horizontal scroll. Hero: full-width carousel of food photography (~60% viewport height), left arrow, pagination dots. Right-side promo card overlays hero edge: \"Customize your Good Eggs experience\" with $15 offer, \"Dismiss\" and \"TAKE THE QUIZ\" pill buttons, \"SHOP SUMMER SIDES\" link below. Headline absent from hero; promo card carries messaging. Below: \"Featured Categories\" left-aligned, 5-column grid of category cards with bottom labels. Balance: image-dominant, promo card as anchored sidebar intrusion.\n\nTYPE: Sans-serif (Graphik) throughout. Body medium weight, tight leading. Promo headline ~24px bold, body ~14px. Category labels ~12px. Minimal scale jump, utilitarian hierarchy.\n\nCOLOR: Background #ffffff; text near-black; accent #a54324 (terracotta) on location pin, promo underline; buttons #0f5a3c dark green fill with white text; #df8c0c (honey) in food imagery; warm neutrals #dbd1bd, #a59574 in UI.\n\nSIGNATURE: Promotional card as persistent overlay panel breaking into hero carousel edge, with dual-dismiss options (text link + green CTA pill) and secondary text link below.",
   "palette": ["#df8c0c", "#f3d0a0", "#a54324", "#a59574", "#dbd1bd"],
   "fonts": ["Concrette M-TRIAL", "Graphik"],
   "mode": "light",
   "macro": "bento-grid",
   "axes": "light / grotesk-sans / chromatic-other (~68) / Concrette M-TRIAL",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial · food-beverage, ecommerce · warm, calm, soft · hero-with-cta, bento-grid, feature-trio, logo-cloud, testimonial-wall, newsletter-signup, blog-grid"
  },
  {
   "slug": "beardmeatsfood-co-uk--podcast",
   "title": "Beard Meats Food · Podcast",
   "northstar": "High-contrast brutalist roar, chunky white type on charcoal with neon lime sparks",
   "autopsy": "FOLD: Top nav: hamburger left, logo center, \"SHOP\" button right. Headline: All-caps, center-aligned, massive scale, 1 line (\"BREAKING BEARD PODCAST\"). Supporting copy: Center-aligned, 3 lines, sans-serif. CTAs: Three small circular social icons (YouTube, Spotify, Apple) centered below copy. Hero visual: Four video thumbnails in a horizontal grid occupying bottom 40% of viewport. Headline/copy centered in top 60% of black void.\nTYPE: Display: Heavy, wide, condensed sans-serif (Thunder); Body: Standard geometric sans (Roboto). Extreme scale jump between headline and body.\nCOLOR: BG: #000000; Text: #FFFFFF; Accent: #f0c43c (yellow) used for jagged \"zigzag\" line ornaments on left and right margins.\nSIGNATURE: A black-and-white checkered racing stripe spanning the full width of the page, separating the navigation bar from the hero section.",
   "palette": ["#f0c43c", "#dc5c5c", "#7a191e", "#a88a81", "#cfc0c0"],
   "fonts": ["Thunder", "Roboto"],
   "mode": "dark",
   "macro": "marquee-hero",
   "axes": "mid / grotesk-sans / warm / Thunder",
   "tags": "brutalism, dark-mode · creator, food-beverage · loud, raw · hero-with-cta, blog-grid"
  },
  {
   "slug": "mooala-com",
   "title": "Mooala | Organic Plant Based Milk for the Whole Family - Mooala Brands",
   "northstar": "Warm, softly textured ochre - clean, friendly sans serif - expansive, gentle negative space.",
   "palette": ["#a46a21", "#e8c190", "#64380f", "#ac8464", "#ccb9ab"],
   "fonts": ["Libre Baskerville", "DM Sans"],
   "mode": "light",
   "macro": "bento-grid",
   "axes": "mid / roman-serif / chromatic-other (~67) / Libre Baskerville",
   "tags": "minimalism, editorial, swiss · food-beverage, ecommerce · calm, warm, soft · hero-fullbleed, logo-cloud, hero-with-cta"
  }
 ]
}
